what: PREREG_HUNT 2 data identity: the coins30 manifest and the content hash of the arrays read
rule: sha256 over the arrays in order (5m: ts o h l c v qv; funding: ts rate), each as 'name|dtype|shape' newline then its raw C-order bytes

format.5m: np.savez_compressed; keys ts(int64 ms open time UTC),o,h,l,c,v(base vol),qv(quote vol),mo,mh,ml,mc (mark price OHLC, NaN where no mark bar); all float32 except ts
format.funding: np.savez_compressed; keys ts(int64 ms calc_time UTC), rate(float64 last_funding_rate)

notes: rows are raw exchange bars: nothing forward-filled or synthesized, zero-volume bars kept
ts converted to ms if source used microseconds
every monthly and daily zip was checked against its .CHECKSUM (sha256); see checksum_status_counts and daily_fill.daily_status

monthly archives miss whole days for some coins (klines 2022-02-26..28 and 2022-04-01..02 on 11 coins; mark price on 2021-07-01, 2021-07-24..27, 2022-07-31, 2022-10-02, 2023-02-24, 2026-06-29 and others); these were filled from the official daily archives (daily_fill), inserting only absent bars / NaN mark values

after a coin stops trading the archive can keep producing flat zero-volume bars and fixed funding rows: use last_nonzero_volume_bar as the end of the tradable period; trailing_zero_volume_days and funding_rows_after_last_traded_bar measure that tail
the *_while_trading fields count gaps only up to last_nonzero_volume_bar
